name: Ultramarine / ink / hot apricot
color_space: Opaque sRGB. Ink roles are context-specific. No opacity multiplication on body/time/status ink.

identity.peer_avatars: Keep existing four-slot UUID mapping. Paired light/dark avatar colors retain each contact identity.
identity.geometry: Retain existing committed V silhouette and path geometry. Recolor only.
identity.placement: Launcher uses ultramarine background, ivory left branch, apricot right branch. In-app/onboarding use the same blue badge beneath the two branches so ivory never disappears on warm paper. Same colorway in dark. Native OS monochrome mask geometry remains unchanged.
identity.supersedes: Exact evergreen/lime colors were superseded by the owner; preserve the V geometry, not the old colors.

state_rules: Use outgoing_ink/outgoing_secondary/outgoing_read/outgoing_failed inside saturated own bubbles. Generic secondary/read/error is for canvas/surface/incoming only.
Unread count uses action/on_action; own bubble remains ultramarine in both themes.
Practice word = peach fill/rust ink; current spoken word = vivid amber fill/dark ink. Playback position remains distinct from learned-word selection.
Focus ring uses focus on canvas/surface/incoming and outgoing_focus on saturated own bubbles. Use outline for editable boundary; separators are decorative.

Read gold double-check tint supplements localized status/AX. Delivered/pending use outgoing_secondary on own bubble or secondary elsewhere. Keep clock/check/error shapes and localized text. Where read and delivered share a double-check shape, expose localized Read in visible metadata/status inspection so hue is not the sole cue.
Failure retains error icon and localized failure/retry wording; do not use warm brand accent as failure.
